definitions.explanation: A scholarly periodical published by a university, research institute, or academic society, collecting research articles by its members. Often includes work that may be more exploratory or local in scope than articles in peer-reviewed international journals.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{紀要|きよう}。
⟦{論文|ろんぶん}→論文：03787_ronbun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{紀要|きよう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{投稿|とうこう}する→投稿する：18994_toukousuru⟧。
examples.english: To submit a paper to an academic bulletin.

examples.japanese: ⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{成果|せいか}→成果：06745_seika⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{所属|しょぞく}→所属：12750_shozoku⟧⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{紀要|きよう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{掲載|けいさい}して→掲載する：19217_keisaisuru⟧⟦もらう→もらう：00520_morau⟧ことになった。
examples.english: It has been decided that the results of my research will be published in the bulletin of my home university.

notes:
Composed of {紀|き} (record, chronicle) and ⟦{要|よう}→要：10000_you⟧ (important, essential matter). In modern Japanese academic life, {紀要|きよう} refers specifically to the in-house scholarly publications of a university or institute. They are important venues for early-career researchers and for work reporting on local or Japan-specific topics.

This word is a homophone of ⟦{器用|きよう}→器用：02655_kiyou⟧ (dexterous) and ⟦{起用|きよう}→起用：14397_kiyou⟧ (to appoint, to recruit). Context — usually "university," "paper," "publish" — makes the meaning clear.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧{紀要|きよう}: a university bulletin
- {紀要|きよう}⟦{論文|ろんぶん}→論文：03787_ronbun⟧: a paper published in a bulletin
- {紀要|きよう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{掲載|けいさい}する→掲載する：19217_keisaisuru⟧: to publish in a bulletin
- {紀要|きよう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{投稿|とうこう}する→投稿する：18994_toukousuru⟧: to submit to a bulletin

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{学会誌|がっかいし}→学会誌：25730_gakkaishi⟧: academic society journal — published by a learned society
- {学術誌|がくじゅつし}: academic journal (general term)
- ⟦{論文|ろんぶん}→論文：03787_ronbun⟧: research paper
- {専門誌|せんもんし}: specialized journal/magazine
